UpdateStageDescription: Downloads the Java 25 runtime required by the TotK server.
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd totk-online-multiplayer-server && rm -rf java && rm -f java.tar.gz && wget -qO java.tar.gz https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/25/ga/linux/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse && mkdir -p java && tar -xzf java.tar.gz -C java --strip-components=1 && rm -f java.tar.gz && chmod +x java/bin/java && java/bin/java --version"
